• Main MSRC run: 500,000 requests, 910 us average response, 69 redirects, no migration at critical threshold 15.
• Forced migration check: 40,960 migration-write sectors were added to cumulative WAM exactly.
• Read/write wait check: 32 reads and 32 writes waited; 64 requests replayed; early write completion remained zero.
• Endurance check: 43 bad blocks + 9 pending retirements consumed the 52-block OP reserve and stopped simulation.
• EXP-02 through EXP-05 are functional checks and must not be used as performance benchmarks.
